residentEvil.title: Resident Evil (PlayStation, 1996)
residentEvil.evidence: Chris's mansion entry has a real corridor, a door transition, a new room, and a threat revealed after moving farther. The picture shows when room and input cues return, not the internal loading completion signal.
residentEvil.label: 바이오하자드 (1996)

comparison.teachingRole: Contrast necessary or meaningful wait with idle time where no new choice or clue is visible. Model the internal loading-complete boundary separately rather than guessing it from a retail capture.

sonic.title: Sonic the Hedgehog (2006) · Very Hard Mode (DLC)
sonic.label: 소닉 더 헤지혹 (2006)
sonic.evidence: Loading indicator visible before Wave Ocean stage card, the scene then begins at about 7.8s in this specific recording. No universal console load time asserted.

luigi.title: Luigi’s Mansion 3
luigi.label: 루이지 맨션 3
luigi.evidence: Polterpup draws Luigi to a vehicle and Luigi takes out the Poltergust. The item and its lamp become visible. Control UI returns before the interaction prompt.
